## Spec — Show how many invoices are listed next to the Invoices heading ### Plan Today `/invoices` renders a plain `

Invoices

` above a table of all five seeded invoices, and nothing on the page says how many rows are listed. After the change the heading reads **`Invoices (5)`** — the number of rows the table actually renders, derived from the same `invoices` array that `` maps over, so the heading and the table cannot disagree. There is **no status filter in this app today** (`grep` for `status` across `app/`, `components/` and `lib/` finds only the `Invoice.status` field, the sent/paid rule inside `exportableInvoices`, the CSV header column and HTTP status codes). So the request's "after any status filter" is honoured by taking the count from the rendered array rather than from `listInvoices()` or `exportableInvoices()` — if a filter is added later the heading follows it with no further change. Adding a filter is not part of this work item — that is issue #27, and this change is deliberately written so it needs no follow-up when #27 lands. Two constraints for the builder: - The count must be interpolated in a **single template literal**, not as adjacent JSX children. React 19.3.1's server renderer turns `

Invoices ({n})

` into `

Invoices (5)

`; one template literal gives `

Invoices (5)

`. The existing `Total sent:` line already carries a comment saying exactly this. - **No new `lib/` function.** `invoices.length` is the whole computation, and `fundamentals.md` asks for one domain module rather than a second near-duplicate of an existing one. `ExportButton` keeps its own count from `exportableInvoices` (3) and is untouched: the heading counts rows shown, the button counts rows exported, and those are deliberately different numbers. ### Files the builder may touch - `app/invoices/page.tsx` - `app/invoices/page.test.tsx` Feature folder: `app/invoices` ### Acceptance checks 1. Load ` (localhost/redacted) in a browser: the page's first heading reads exactly `Invoices (5)` instead of `Invoices\`. 2. Count the body rows of the table under that heading: there are 5 (INV-1001 ... INV-1005), which is the number shown in the heading. 3. `curl -s (localhost/redacted) | grep -F 'Invoices (5)'` finds the literal string, with no \`\` markers between `Invoices (`, `5` and `)`. 4. On the same page the export button still reads `Export 3 invoices as CSV` — the heading's 5 counts the rows listed, not the 3 that are exportable — and clicking it still downloads a CSV of 3 invoices. ### Tests **Added** (both in `app/invoices/page.test.tsx`): - "shows how many invoices are listed, so a reader does not have to count the rows" — renders `InvoicesPage`, asserts the `

` text is exactly `Invoices (5)` and that the number in it equals the count of ` ` elements rendered. - "counts the rows on the page, not the exportable ones, so the heading cannot read (3) while five rows are visible" — asserts the heading is not `Invoices (3)` while the export button still reads `Export 3 invoices as CSV`. **Changed:** `app/invoices/page.test.tsx` (existing file; the two existing `Total sent` cases are left alone). ### Research | Claim | Source | | --- | --- | | The heading to change is a bare `

Invoices

`; rows shown is `invoices.length` (5), not the `exportable.length` (3) already passed to the button. | `app/invoices/page.tsx:11` | | No status filter exists, so the count comes from the array the table maps over. | `ran: grep -rn "status" app components lib --include=*.ts --include=*.tsx` | | Adjacent JSX children render as `Invoices (5)`; one template literal renders as `Invoices (5)`. Verified against the repo's own React 19.3.1. | `ran: node` probe calling `renderToString` on both forms | | No new `lib/` function: prefer widening one domain module over a near-duplicate. | `.factory/definition/context/fundamentals.md:74` | | New cases go in the existing colocated test file, which is why it is declared under `tests_changed`. | `app/invoices/page.test.tsx:7` | | The sandbox (tier `renders`) can serve, curl, screenshot and click this page; `app/invoices/page.tsx` is at 100% line coverage today, so the 80% diff-coverage floor is met. | `ran: npm ci && npm test -- --coverage` (28 tests pass) | | Nothing here is a protected path, and no lint baseline moves. | `.factory/definition/policy.yaml:33` | `bsf spec check --pipeline product_work` passes on this spec. > Generated by [Spec](https://github.com/bsf-fixtures/ts-webapp/actions/runs/44927093682) · claude · opus50 · \~93 AIC · ⌖ \~19 AIC · ⊞ 2.6K · [◷](https://github.com/search?q=repo%3Absf-fixtures%2Fts-webapp+%22gh-aw-workflow-call-id%3A+bsf-fixtures%2Fts-webapp%2Ffactory-role-spec%22&type=issues)
